The dedupe proposed under the B2 budget (warnings in one table; reports and records once per tile shard) is not built and would change D30's one-file-per-tap rule.

The joins are not on the B5 clock: joins.py counts its 35 minutes from its own start, so a join that starts about 11 minutes into the job and uses its full limit can leave no time before the pack. The fix is a job-clock deadline in joins.py (a flag), or the products pulls in their own non-fatal step with a deadline. The supervisor also rules on D26's non-fatal wording for the join: it stays fatal now, by the B2 rule (a crash could publish a half-written store, since only the verify follows).

The station carry and drop edit index.json with jq; the carry does not refresh manifest.json, and the drop removes the block only, not a failed run's sd/ files or manifest entries. The tested stations command, the containment step (run hail.check_manifest; on failure, or if containment itself fails, remove the B5 folders and their manifest entries, set the five blocks to unavailable with the D16 sentence, and delete hidden .stations-<8 random characters> temp files) and the fatal B1 and B2 gates after containment need a stations command (owner: stations.py). Until then a stations run that fails after writing some sd/ files can leave files the manifest does not list, and the site build would refuse the store.

D26's daily NWPS scope is not built: the daily gauges step reads only the files missing from the cache. The list and the 192 pool details (about 45 s at the measured 0.23 s a request) need a daily flag and a test; the gauges block's read dates (list, details and peaks) and the sources rows for nwps_gauges and usgs_water_api (their timing text) follow with that code. The supervisor decides whether details means the pool or all 486 gauges.

The monthly NOHRSC revision check: a daily rebuild replaces the whole snow block, so the next daily run erases the check's record (the snow module keeps it through the rebuild). The daily run makes no request; the timing text in sources.py and snowgrid.py that says so waits for that code.

The store asset hail-store keeps its fixed name: the site build reads releases/download/hail-store/hail-store.tar.gz (website/hail.py, STORE_URL). A versioned store name needs the reader to take the newest name first. The climate archive has the versioned name.
